reason: The candidate call would modify order #W1845024 by removing the keyboard, headphones, and office chair items, but modify_pending_order_items only supports exchanging items for a different item of the SAME product type — it cannot remove items outright, and the call's new_item_ids list is empty, which does not correspond to any valid new item for those products. The policy states modify actions can change an item to 'an available new item of the same product but of different product option' and explicitly prohibits removal-only or product-type changes. The user's confirmed request (remove three items, keep two, refund the difference) is actually a request for partial cancellation/removal, which is not a supported action under 'Modify items' — the correct tool for removing items entirely does not exist in this policy; only full order cancellation or item-for-item exchange within the same product type is permitted. Calling modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids to achieve outright removal is not a supported use of that tool and violates the policy's item modification rules.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
